task.title: The file /work/app.log holds one event per line, like `2025-01-02 ERROR disk full`.
task.body:
The file /work/app.log holds one event per line, like `2025-01-02 ERROR disk full`.
Count the lines at each level and write /work/counts.json as {"ERROR": n, "INFO": n}.
Count only ERROR and INFO; ignore DEBUG lines.
Run `python3 check.py` to verify.
